fusions.name: Cut-Off Call
fusions.desc: Throws a sharp cry into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 30% chance of leaving the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dawn Chorus
fusions.desc: Sings out in a ring, dealing 24 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, every ally near you strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Perfect Pitch
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Verse
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
